executive_summary: Zara's Fashion Store has strong design appeal with customers liking the visual style, but critical pain points are sizing accuracy and fabric quality. Of 10 reviews, 3 are positive, 2 negative, and 5 mixed. The most urgent issue is wrong size delivery (ordered L, received S) — indicating a warehouse packing error. Fabric quality complaints and poor elastic are recurring themes. Return/exchange difficulty amplifies customer frustration. Recommend: (1) warehouse size verification process, (2) fabric supplier quality audit, (3) streamlined exchange policy.
